app.name: Avimétrica Pro
app.tagline: Poultry weight, uniformity and performance analytics
app.logoAlt: Avimétrica Pro — Poultry weight, uniformity and performance analytics

aves.description: Individual bird weighing, flock uniformity and comparison against breed standard targets.

huevos.description: Egg weight sampling, distribution analysis and automatic grading into size categories.

generico.description: Statistical analysis of any quantitative variable, with real or experimental data, for teaching and practice.
generico.sameEngine: It uses the same verified statistical engine as the bird and egg modules, so a classroom exercise and a production analysis are solved with the same tools.

criterion.label: Uniformity criterion (band around the mean)
criterion.note: Uniformity is the % of birds within mean ±{pct}%. It is a descriptive band, not a confidence interval.

descriptive.censusLabel: The whole flock was weighed (census) — use population formulas (n). If it is a sample, leave unchecked (sample formulas, n−1).
descriptive.bandsTitle: Proportion of birds within mean ± X%
descriptive.approximate: ⚠️ approximate data, no audited official guide
descriptive.withinGuide: Within the guide range: {dentro}% of the birds · below target: {debajo}% · above: {encima}%
descriptive.standardized: Standardized index vs. target: {z} standard deviations

histogram.svgAltOverlay: Histogram of {n} weights in {clases} bins with an overlaid normal curve
histogram.caption: Weight (g) — {modo}, {clases} bins ({regla})
histogram.legendBars: Bars: actual empirical distribution of the {n} weights.
histogram.legendCurve: Blue line: theoretical normal fitted with the flock's mean and sample SD.
histogram.legendLines: Dashed lines: mean (μ), median and the uniformity criterion limits.

reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all data and start a new test?
